countries.name: Austria
countries.summary: Not confirmed — ask the embassy before booking. Some sources report this country may require a visa from UK travel document holders.
notes: Schengen rule: up to 90 days in any 180-day period, counted across ALL Schengen countries together.

Legal basis: the EU lets each Schengen state exempt refugees and stateless people who live in the UK (Regulation 2018/1806, Art. 6(2)). The 2023 EU notice shows most states do, 'subject to reciprocity and overall EU–UK relations'.
Your travel document must be valid for at least 3 months after you leave the Schengen area and issued within the last 10 years.
Expect biometric registration (fingerprints and photo) at the border under the EU Entry/Exit System.
